source.description: The shard source: its alias, its shorthand, or its folder, for example "proj" or "Shards/(Source Remote) Projects".

commit.description: The SHA of the commit of the migration in the source. Set it in the step commit.

next.interactive: Load the source {{source}} with flint shard start-dev, run flint shard knap check-modes on its folder, check git status, and write the plan: each headless file and the stage that handles it. Give the plan to the person.
next.headless: Load the source {{source}} with flint shard start-dev, run flint shard knap check-modes on its folder, check git status, and write the plan: each headless file and the stage that handles it. Keep the plan for the result. Do not wait for a person.

steps.title: Merge the Workflows
steps.next: Merge each dev-hwkfl- workflow of {{source}} that has a partner into its dev-wkfl- workflow: a headless callout at the end of each stage that differs, nothing lost, no --headless. Then git rm the headless file. When the source has no pair, skip this step: flint shard step skip workflows --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

steps.title: Merge the Invocation Files
steps.next: Merge each headless invocation file of {{source}} into the dev-wkfl- file: format 0.3, a next object where the texts differ, modes on a step of one mode, the union of the behaviours. Then git rm the headless file. When the source has no headless invocation file, skip this step: flint shard step skip invocation_files --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

steps.title: Merge the Init
steps.next: Move the content of the headless init of {{source}} into a section # Headless of the init: the interface keys, the phase values, the result delivery. Then git rm the headless init. When the source has no headless init, skip this step: flint shard step skip init --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

steps.title: A Headless Workflow with No Partner
steps.stage: Stage 5: A Headless Workflow with No Partner
steps.next: Rename each dev-hwkfl- workflow of {{source}} with no partner to dev-wkfl-, keep it as a normal workflow with real stage headings, and add the line that it runs in a headless Orbh session. When each headless workflow has a partner, skip this step: flint shard step skip alone --invocation {{invocation}} --reason '<why>'.

steps.title: Update the Links
steps.next: Replace each link to a headless file, each hstart, and each --headless in the files of {{source}}. Keep the release history. Then run flint shard knap check-modes on the folder again.

steps.title: Check
steps.next: Run flint shard knap check-modes on the folder of {{source}}, and the health check of the shard. No headless file, no reference, no problem, and no deprecated warning may stay.

steps.title: Review
steps.next: Give the person the summary of the migration of {{source}}: the merged, renamed, and deleted files, each dropped line, each choice, and the check. Refine until the person confirms.

steps.title: Commit and Version
steps.next: Bump the version of {{source}} (minor at 1.0.0 or above, patch for 0.x), and commit only your paths: git commit -- <path>, with each path. Then set the output: flint shard invocations set-output {{invocation}} commit='<sha>'.

next.interactive: Search the other sources and the Mesh for the old names of the files of {{source}}, and list each place for the person. Do not edit another shard. Then close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done.
next.headless: Search the other sources and the Mesh for the old names of the files of {{source}}, and put the list in the result. Do not edit another shard. Close the invocation: flint shard invocations close {{invocation}} --outcome done. Then return with flint orbh session return --finish.
